observations.body: David ascends barefoot and weeping, hears Ahithophel has joined Absalom, prays for foolish counsel, and sends Hushai back to frustrate it through the priests’ sons.
observations.label: Weeping, worship, and counter-counsel on the ascent: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps David, the people, Ahithophel, Hushai, priests, and their sons, the Mount of Olives and Jerusalem, ascending, covering heads, weeping, worshiping, praying, assigning, returning, and reporting visible within David's story or later memory.
observations.label: Weeping, worship, and counter-counsel on the ascent: action, promise, or consequence

observations.label: Relationships named in 2 Samuel 15:30–37

payload.posture: Read 2 Samuel 15:30–37 as its own exile, return, and rebellion David setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places lament and strategy occupy the same retreat inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
